pilot.rule: smallest epochs within 0.5 accuracy points of the best grid cell (mean over the two pilot tasks), then the best learning rate at those epochs

probe.test: 1,000 validation images x 5 presentations, a ~ N(0,1)

manifest.experiment: E9, the shape of the noise (protocol section 15)

shapes.variance: 1 + mu^2 for every shape, zero mean, independent of the class
shapes.two: +-sqrt(1 + mu^2) with probability one half each
shapes.t3: Student's t with 3 degrees of freedom divided by sqrt(3), times sqrt(1 + mu^2)

keys.image: index in the CIFAR-10 test set
keys.a: frame value shown, shape (4, N): one row per shape, in the order of `shapes`
keys.z_plus: log-odds of the plus network, shape (4, N)
keys.z_minus: the same for the minus network
keys.val_*: the same on validation (val_image: CIFAR-10 training index)

manifest.layout: each image appears 5 times in a row (np.repeat), with independent frames
manifest.training: as E1: all the 9,000 training images of the task, frame a ~ N(+-mu, 1) according to the class, with opposite signs for plus and minus
manifest.frame: the outer 2-pixel border of all three channels is set to a * delta, in normalised units (after per-channel normalisation), applied after crop and flip, without clipping
manifest.torch_seeds: the labels of E1 on new seeds: crc32('bench/<task>/s<seed>/<plus|minus>') & 0x7fffffff
manifest.test_and_validation_frames: numpy default_rng(crc32('shape/<task>/s<seed>/<test|val>-<shape>')), unit variance, times sqrt(1 + mu^2)

hyperparameters.network: Net of turing-meter experiments/angle-between-errors/gpu/silicon.py with a 2-way head: conv3x3 48-96, maxpool, 96-192, maxpool, 192, global average pool, linear; BatchNorm and ReLU after every convolution
hyperparameters.optimiser: SGD, Nesterov momentum 0.9, weight decay 5e-4, one-cycle schedule (PyTorch OneCycleLR defaults), bf16 autocast
hyperparameters.augmentation: random 32x32 crop of the image reflect-padded by 4 pixels, random horizontal flip

deviations: shared GPU: the driver stopped twice to give the GPU back to another user and started again when it was free. Three sessions on 2026-11-19, UTC: 09:49 to 10:15, 10:19 to 11:27, 19:20 to 20:13. A unit is written when it ends; the units under way at a stop were run again from the start, with the same seeds. stage_time is the last session only: the seconds of each unit are in unit_seconds
all the 75 units were written in the third session
environment built again for these runs: numpy 2.5.5 (E1 to E5: 2.5.4); python, torch, torchvision, CUDA and cuDNN as in E1 to E5

settings.ratio: tuned turing over Tu_app from k and rho of the same unit and shape, as in H1c
settings.pair: z_H + w z_M at the geometric mean of the two tuned weights, for the kurtosis and the signal-to-noise ratio

S1.rule: with the Gaussian frame, at mu = 1.5 and 2: the angle is above 90 degrees in every unit and the median of tuned turing / Tu_app is within [0.9, 1.1] (H1a and H1c of E1, on seeds E1 never used)

S2.rule: at mu = 2 the median ratio is below 0.9 both with the two-valued frame and with the t frame: the formula promises more than the pair gives

S3.rule: at mu = 1.5 the two shapes go opposite ways: the median ratio is above 1 with the two-valued frame and below 0.95 with the t frame

S4.rule: with the uniform frame the median ratio stays within [0.95, 1.1] at mu = 1.5 and 2

S5.rule: the pair itself does not depend on the shape, because in the pair the frame cancels: d of the tuned pair over that with the Gaussian frame, median within [0.95, 1.05] for every shape at mu = 1.5 and 2
